title: Albums from MusicBrainz
text:
Download Albums
We fetch the release groups for Pink Floyd and Stone Temple Pilots via the MusicBrainz API, filtering for studio albums.

fetch_albums <- function(artist_id, artist_name) {
  url <- paste0(
    "https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/release-group?artist=",
    artist_id,
    "&limit=100&fmt=json"
  )
  
  res <- request(url) |>
    req_headers("User-Agent" = "CourseProject/1.0 (student@example.edu)") |>
    req_retry(
      max_tries = 5,
      is_transient = \(resp) resp_status(resp) %in% c(429, 503),
      backoff = \(i) i * 2
    ) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json()
  
  rgs <- res[["release-groups"]]
  
  tibble(
    artist = artist_name,
    title = map_chr(rgs, "title"),
    primary_type = map_chr(rgs, \(x) x[["primary-type"]] %||% NA_character_),
    secondary_types = map_chr(rgs, \(x) paste(x[["secondary-types"]], collapse = ", ")),
    release_date = map_chr(rgs, \(x) x[["first-release-date"]] %||% NA_character_)
  ) |>
    filter(primary_type == "Album", secondary_types == "") |>
    select(artist, title, release_date)
}

# MBIDs for Pink Floyd and Stone Temple Pilots
artists <- tribble(
  ~artist, ~id,
  "Pink Floyd", "83d91898-7763-47d7-b03b-b92132375c47",
  "Stone Temple Pilots", "8c32bb01-58a3-453b-8050-8c0620edb0e5"
)

albums <- map2(artists$id, artists$artist, fetch_albums) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  arrange(artist, release_date)

write_csv(albums, "albums.csv")
